trap.label: phrasal verb
trap.wrong: After the argument, he gave up and let me choose the film.
trap.right: After the argument, he gave in and let me choose the film.
trap.why: Em português "desistir" e "ceder" são confundidos. Give up = desistir de algo; give in = ceder a alguém.

fix.wrong: He gave up after a long argument and accepted my idea.
fix.right: He gave in after a long argument and accepted my idea.

fix.wrong: She gave me a gift for my birthday to.
fix.right: She gave me a gift for my birthday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com give up: “She stopped trying.”
Reescreva com give away: “He donated his books.”
